description: This is a shell script used for testing, specifically for adding and editing files with git. It includes setup commands, file contents manipulation, and test cases to verify functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, executes given commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Records the current timestamp for use in testing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands that are expected to fail, verifying failure conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_set_editor
methods.description: Sets a custom editor script for git operations in the test environment.
